name: Global Bounded-Sum Obfuscation
description: Replaces the local per-edge determinant condition with a global sum over all edges: $\sum (2s_u - 3)(2s_v - 3) = -m$. Since $s \in \{1, 2\}$, each term is $\ge -1$, so the sum equals $-m$ if and only if every term is exactly $-1$, which strictly requires $s_u \neq s_v$ for every edge. This defeats models by requiring a multi-step algebraic deduction (global sum of bounded terms achieves theoretical minimum $\implies$ all local terms are minimized) to uncover the underlying bipartite graph structure, preventing immediate pattern matching to graph coloring.
